correctness.rationale: Single-cap reduction is valid since one-cap data are admissible: the claimed bound then becomes ||F||_{L6(Y)} <= C_eps R^eps (M/W)^{1/6} ||F||_{L6(w)}. With N~R^{3/2} disjoint parallel tubes each meeting L~R^{1/2} grid balls, per-ball mass b, F=phi_T0+delta sum_{j>=1}phi_Tj and delta^6=1/(N-1), disjoint L6^6 additivity gives LHS^6=Lb and global mass=2Lb, so RHS^6=(M/W)*2Lb=(1/N)*2Lb and ratio=(N/2)^{1/6}~cR^{1/4}. Re-ran scaling_check.py: log-log slope 0.2500 and ratio/R^{1/8} monotone 1.26..5.04, confirming exact arithmetic. W=NL is correct under the stated definition since every tube carries nonzero mass and tails jointly carry half the global mass; mu=1 by disjointness. Ef-realization via standard cap wave-packet expansion up to absolute-constant Schwartz tails is standard calculus; the R^{1/4} power gap absorbs all absolute constants, boundary-tube and weight w vs indicator errors. No load-bearing conjecture remains.

originality.rationale: Fused literature search (SerpBase Top10, OpenAlex Top15, Crossref Top15, OpenAIRE per query, all providers ok, no partial failure) plus full fetch of decisive sources shows no prior source states or substantively implies this exact 3+1-cone L6 sparse (M/W)^{1/6} falsification with the two-scale single-cap family (N~R^{3/2}, M~R^{1/2}, W~R^2, mu=1, violation R^{1/4}). Known refined-decoupling theorems prove positive bounds only under dyadic amplitude uniformity or pigeonholing, and sharp examples show tightness of the true form, not falsity of this naive form. The closest falsification (Singh-Parmar 2026 collar against a planar Falconer arbitrary-packet form) uses a different geometry, mechanism, and estimate. General folklore that uniformity is needed does not exhibit this explicit R^{1/4} family, so the headline is not a recomputation, corollary, or repackaging of a known stronger fact.

It isolates amplitude non-uniformity invisible to (M,W,mu-on-Y) as the exact failure mechanism, explains why dyadic pigeonholing and mu-penalties cannot rescue the stated data, and identifies the needed repair (uniformity or spread factor). The object (truncated light cone, canonical caps, sparse R^{1/2}-ball unions) and invariant (L6 sparse refinement exponent) were motivated before computation, the value was not known or mechanically implied, and a future researcher needs this precise negative fact to avoid using the naive form. No ADMISSION_DEFECT.
